title: mockupCapture
responsibility: Render static mockup documents headlessly at their declared viewports.

inputs.name: mockupCapture.captures
inputs.description: Isolated static documents, each with its viewport, state, option, and color scheme.

inputs.name: mockupCapture.signal
inputs.description: Cancellation signal for the Plan run. Cancellation closes its browser.

outputs.name: mockupCapture
outputs.description: PNG screenshot bytes in the requested capture order.

errors.name: MockupFailure
errors.description: Playwright Chromium and installed Chrome were both unavailable.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: The Plan owner cancelled before or during rendering.
